claude.description: Connect services through NyxID's credential broker and call their APIs without exposing API keys or OAuth tokens to Claude.

codex.description: Use NyxID to connect services and access them through its credential broker.

interface.longDescription: Use NyxID to discover connected services, start a hosted connection, and invoke authorized operations through its credential broker. Sign-in and credential entry happen on NyxID's website. Available actions depend on your account's service grants and approval settings.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect a service in NyxID.
List my GitHub repositories through NyxID.

codex.release_notes: Ships a single MCP-first NyxID skill instead of the CLI skill family, declares behavior hints on every tool, and explains how to share more services with the app.
